TS2307: Import from "denext", not "react"
  at react-import.tsx:3:26

    2 | "use client";
  > 3 | import { useState } from "react";
                                 ^^^^^^^
    4 | import Link from "next/link";

  "react" is not a dependency of a denext app: denext provides that API itself. Hooks and core APIs come from denext. There is no `react` package (a drop-in aliases it). The full mapping is the "Next.js → denext import map" in AGENTS.md (also the `denext_import_map` tool of `denext mcp`).

  Fix: Change the import:
  import { useState } from "react";
  → import { useState } from "denext";

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS2307 [ERROR]: Cannot find module 'react' or its corresponding type declarations.
  │ import { useState } from "react";
  │                          ~~~~~~~
  │     at file:///app/react-import.tsx:3:26

TS2307: Import from "denext", not "next/link"
  at react-import.tsx:4:18

    3 | import { useState } from "react";
  > 4 | import Link from "next/link";
                         ^^^^^^^^^^^
    5 | 

  "next/link" is not a dependency of a denext app: denext provides that API itself. `import { Link } from "denext"` (or denext/client). It is a named export, not default. The full mapping is the "Next.js → denext import map" in AGENTS.md (also the `denext_import_map` tool of `denext mcp`).

  Fix: Change the import:
  import Link from "next/link";
  → import { Link } from "denext";

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS2307 [ERROR]: Cannot find module 'next/link' or its corresponding type declarations.
  │ import Link from "next/link";
  │                  ~~~~~~~~~~~
  │     at file:///app/react-import.tsx:4:18
